text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity here. In the first scene, the glass-walled meeting space suggests order, possibility, and quiet preparation—an environment awaiting human presence and purpose. The second scene, with its bold colors and "R+D" (Research and Development) theme, excites me with the promise of innovation and collaboration. Here, I feel the collective effort to push boundaries and imagine new futures. The air seems charged with creative intent, making me reflect on the nature of progress and our endless desire to understand, connect, and transform the world around us.
